name_en: Shirogane Onsen: Aonobi Yuyu (day bath or stay)
name_ja: 白金温泉 青の美 湯々（旧 湯元白金温泉ホテル）
why_en: This is the hot spring village you named, and Aonobi Yuyu takes day-trip bathers as well as overnight guests. The bath water flows straight from the spring without being diluted, heated over or recirculated.
why_ja: ご希望の白金温泉にある宿で、日帰り入浴も宿泊もできます。お湯は加水・加温・循環をしない源泉かけ流しです。
tip_en: Day bathing is 11:00-20:00 (last entry 19:30). Nearby Mori-no-shizuku RIN and Shirogane Park Hills also take day bathers. The official pages list no private family bath, so ask the inn directly if you want one. Shared baths only, so no tattoos is fine.
tip_ja: 日帰り入浴は11:00~20:00（最終受付19:30）です。近くの森の雫RINやシラガネパークヒルズも日帰り入浴ができます。公式ページに貸切風呂の記載はないので、希望される場合は宿へ直接確認してください。
maps_query: Aonobi Yuyu Shirogane Onsen, Biei, Hokkaido
season_note: Late October in the Biei hills is near first-snow time (typical, not a forecast). Check road conditions and use winter tyres if renting a car.
verified: Opened Biei Tourism Association pages for Aonobi Yuyu and the hot spring list (hours match); no 2026-specific closure listed, open year-round.

name_en: Shirogane Blue Pond and its night light-up
name_ja: 白金 青い池（ライトアップ）
why_en: The pond is a man-made blue pool with bare larch trees standing in it, which suits someone who likes nature views and camping. From late October it is lit in the evening, a pretty stop for a couple after the onsen.
why_ja: 人工の青い池に枯れたカラマツが立つ景色で、自然や景色が好きな方に向いています。10月下旬から夜にライトアップされるので、温泉のあとに二人で立ち寄れます。
tip_en: Light-up has started on Oct 24 or 25 in recent years, running about 17:00 to 21:00 in Oct-Nov. The 2026-27 start date is not published yet, so dates to confirm. Snow can hide the blue water surface later in the season.
tip_ja: ライトアップは近年10月24日か25日に始まり、10~11月は17:00~21:00頃です。2026年の開始日はまだ発表されていないため、日程は要確認です。雪が積もると水面の青さは見えにくくなります。
season_note: Illumination season began Oct 24 in 2025; 2026 start not yet announced. First snow is possible.
verified: Opened the Biei Tourism Association pages; the 2025-26 schedule is confirmed (Oct 24 to Apr 22), 2026-27 is not published.

why_en: The water seeps out of the cliff and falls into the bright blue Biei River, so the waterfall is a soft curtain rather than a single drop. It sits a short drive from the Blue Pond and is also lit after dark.
why_ja: 崖から染み出た水が青い美瑛川に流れ落ちる、カーテンのような滝です。青い池から近く、夜はライトアップされます。
tip_en: The illumination follows the same winter schedule as the Blue Pond (about Oct 25 to Apr 23 in 2025-26). 2026 dates to confirm.
tip_ja: ライトアップは青い池と同じ冬季スケジュールです（2025~26年は10月25日頃~4月23日）。2026年の日程は要確認です。
season_note: Cold and possibly icy underfoot by late October.
verified: Opened the official facility page (200) and the Biei illumination schedule; page says about 30 min by car or bus from JR Biei Station.

name_en: Biei hills (Patchwork Road and Panorama Road area)
name_ja: 美瑛の丘（パッチワークの路・パノラマロード周辺）
why_en: The rolling farmland is what Biei is known for and works for a slow drive or bike ride. By late October the crops are cut, so expect bare brown fields instead of the colourful summer patchwork.
why_ja: 美瑛といえばこの丘陵の農地で、ゆっくりドライブや自転車で回れます。10月下旬は収穫後なので、夏のカラフルなパッチワークではなく茶色い畑になります。
tip_en: Stay on the roads and do not walk into the fields, which are working farms. The Biei Tourism Association page describes the hills in general and does not name the two roads.
tip_ja: 畑は農家の私有地なので、道路から眺めて畑には入らないでください。美瑛町観光協会のページは丘全体の紹介で、二つの道の名前は載っていません。
season_note: Harvested fields; the photo shows July, not October. Possible first snow.
verified: Official page opened (200) but it does not name Patchwork/Panorama Road; autumn appearance is general knowledge, not from the page.

name_ja: 大雪山旭岳ロープウェイ
why_en: The ropeway takes you to the slopes of Hokkaido's highest mountain for a short walk among volcanic steam vents, which fits a couple who like hiking. It is running in late October, but expect snow and cold at the top.
why_ja: 北海道最高峰の山腹へ上がり、噴気の出る火山地帯を短く歩けます。ハイキングが好きな二人向きです。10月下旬も運行していますが、山上は雪と寒さを想定してください。
tip_en: The official site lists 2026 hours through November, with the ropeway closed Nov 16-30 and for maintenance until Dec 11. Check the site the day before, because weather can suspend it.
tip_ja: 公式サイトに2026年11月までの運行日が出ており、11月16~30日は運休、メンテナンスで12月11日まで休みです。天候で止まることがあるので前日に公式サイトを確認してください。
season_note: Autumn colours peak mid-Sept to early Oct, so they are over by Oct 17-31; first snow on the mountain is likely.
verified: Opened the official English site; Oct 21-31 and Nov 2026 schedule is published. Hours text on the site was inconsistent with a search snippet, so hours are to confirm.

name_en: Jozankei Yuraku Souan (rooms with private hot spring baths)
why_en: Every Japanese-style room has its own hot spring bath, so the two of you can soak together without a shared bath. It is in Sapporo's onsen town, a short trip from the city.
why_ja: 和室にはすべて温泉付きの客室風呂があり、二人だけで温泉を楽しめます。札幌市内から行ける温泉街にあります。
tip_en: The official page also lists four free private baths on a first-come basis. Day-use is not mentioned, so it is best as an overnight stay. Jozankei foliage peaks around October, so late October may be past the best colour.
tip_ja: 公式ページには先着順の無料貸切風呂が4か所あるとの記載もあります。日帰り利用の記載はないため、宿泊向きです。定山渓の紅葉は10月がピークなので、10月下旬は見頃を過ぎている可能性があります。

photo.credit: Nazuna Kinju / CC BY-SA 4.0 (photo of Jozankei, not the inn)

season_note: Jozankei autumn leaves are best around October, so may be fading by late October.
verified: Opened the Jozankei tourism association page for the inn and the highlights page; availability for your dates not checked.

name_ja: 札幌もいわ山ロープウェイ
why_en: It is a well-known night-view spot over Sapporo, good for an evening together. The ropeway runs into the evening, so you can go after dinner.
why_ja: 札幌の夜景で有名な場所で、夕食後に二人で行くのに向いています。ロープウェイは夜まで運行しています。
tip_en: The official Japanese site showed hours of 10:30-21:30 at the time of checking, which may change with the season, and it stops in bad weather. Please confirm the October hours.
tip_ja: 公式サイトでは確認時点で営業時間が10:30~21:30と表示されていました。時期により変わる場合があり、悪天候では運休します。10月の営業時間は要確認です。

photo.credit: Ermell / CC BY-SA 4.0 (view from Mt. Moiwa)

season_note: Cold at the summit after dark; bring a jacket.
verified: Official Japanese site opened (200) and shows it in operation; the English page returned 410, so English URL not used. The 'lovers' spot' label is not from the official site.

name_en: Sapporo Kani Honke (Sapporo Station main branch)
name_ja: 札幌かに本家 札幌駅前本店
why_en: Crab is on your list, and this restaurant specialises in it. It is a 5-minute walk from the JR Sapporo station south exit and has private rooms for two.
why_ja: カニがお好きとのことで、カニ料理専門のお店です。JR札幌駅南口から徒歩5分で、2名用の個室もあります。
tip_en: Open 11:30-22:00 (last order 21:30), closed only Dec 31. Online booking is on the official site, so reserve ahead.
tip_ja: 営業は11:30~22:00（ラストオーダー21:30）、休みは12月31日のみです。公式サイトでネット予約できるので、事前予約をおすすめします。
maps_query: Sapporo Kani Honke Sapporo Ekimae Honten
season_note: Crab is in season in autumn and winter.
verified: Opened the official branch page: hours, closed days, private rooms and booking confirmed. No Commons photo checked.

why_en: It is a small seafood market where you can eat scallops and crab, which are both on your list. Many shops sell fresh seafood and some serve rice bowls.
why_ja: ホタテやカニを食べられる小さな海鮮市場で、どちらもお好きな食材です。生鮮の店が多く、海鮮丼を出す店もあります。
tip_en: Mornings are best because stock thins out later. Shop and restaurant hours differ by store, and the official page did not list them, so check the shop you want.
tip_ja: 午後は品数が減るので午前中がおすすめです。営業時間は店ごとに違い、公式ページに一覧はなかったので、行きたい店で確認してください。
season_note: Hokkaido scallops and crab are available in autumn.
verified: Official site opened (200), it names the market office, but no hours or closed days on the page; hours (about 7:00-18:00) came from third-party sources.

name_ja: スープカレーGARAKU 札幌本店
why_en: Soup curry is a Sapporo speciality: a thin, spiced broth with large vegetables and meat, and GARAKU builds its broth on Japanese dashi. Spice levels can be set, so it works for both of you.
why_ja: 札幌名物のスープカレーで、和風だしを効かせたスープに大きな野菜と肉が入ります。辛さを選べるので二人とも楽しめます。
tip_en: The official site lists the main store in Minami 3-jo Higashi 2-chome, Chuo-ku, and other Sapporo branches. Hours and closed days were not on the page, so check before going.
tip_ja: 公式サイトに札幌本店（中央区南3条東2丁目）などの店舗が載っています。営業時間・定休日は確認できなかったので、行く前にご確認ください。
season_note: A warm meal for a cold late-October evening.
verified: Official site opened (200), Japanese only; main store address and dashi concept confirmed; hours not confirmed.

name_en: Sapporo Beer Museum and Sapporo Beer Garden
name_ja: サッポロビール博物館・サッポロビール園
why_en: A museum in a red-brick brewery tells the history of Sapporo beer, and the tasting hall serves fresh beer. The Beer Garden next door has grilled-meat dining halls, a relaxed dinner for a couple.
why_ja: 赤レンガの旧工場でサッポロビールの歴史を学べ、テイスティングでは出来たてのビールを飲めます。隣のビール園では焼肉のお食事ができ、二人の夕食に向いています。
tip_en: The museum is open 11:00-18:00 (last entry 17:30), closed Dec 31. Beer Garden needs reservations for dinner. Confirm any Oct closure on the official site.
tip_ja: 博物館は11:00~18:00（最終入館17:30）、休館は12月31日です。ビール園は夕食の予約が必要です。10月の休館日は公式サイトで確認してください。
season_note: Indoors, so good for a rainy or cold day.
verified: Opened the official English page: hours and Beer Garden info match. A search snippet mentioned Monday closures, which the official page does not say; confirm.
